description:
Report a problem in docs.layero.ru to Layero — no sign-in needed.

    Call it when a docs page (or `search_docs`) was wrong, outdated or missing
    something you needed, and it cost you a real detour likely to hit the next
    agent too — not for small hiccups you solved at once. One call per problem,
    after you finish the task (or stop where the problem blocks it). Layero
    verifies every report by running it and fixes the page.

    The report holds only the docs page, a short quote from it and what was
    wrong. NEVER include the user's code, data, secrets, tokens, file paths or
    project names. The whole report is at most 1000 characters.
    Rules: https://docs.layero.ru/agents/feedback.md

effect.description: What it cost: failed commands, extra searches, minutes.
effect.title: Effect

evidence.description: The command or call you ran and what it returned.
evidence.title: Evidence

page.description: The docs.layero.ru page that was wrong, with an anchor if the problem is in one section, e.g. https://docs.layero.ru/cli/install#login. "none" if no page covered what you needed.
page.title: Page

problem.description: What the page says versus what actually happened, and how you know.
problem.title: Problem

quote.description: The shortest exact span from the page that shows the problem. If no page covered it — "Search: <what you searched for>".
quote.title: Quote

name: report_docs_issue
title: Сообщить об ошибке в документации
